name: Privileged Entra Role Assignment
description: Entra roles such as Global Administrator, Privileged Role Administrator, and device admin can change the whole tenant. An attacker who adds themselves or a friend to those roles no longer needs the original phishing victim. Creating a new cloud-only admin user is the same idea with a cleaner audit trail for them. Role assignments into those groups should be rare, dual-controlled, and alerted in real time.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
